Messages.Author: Andy Wilson
Messages.Body:
When you 'steal blood' like with Drain Essence do you keep the blood or put
it in the blood bank.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Andy Wilson wrote:
>
> When you 'steal blood' like with Drain Essence do you keep the blood or put
> it in the blood bank.

You keep the blood. Any blood in excess of the stealing vampire's
capacity goes to the blood bank.
